title: sparganium × diversifolium var. acaule
intro: Sparganium × diversifolium var. acaule, commonly known as burr reed, is a hybrid plant species within the family Typhaceae. This plant is primarily valued for its medicinal properties, which include the potential to provide health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of burr reed include being a demulcent, helping to soothe and protect mucous membranes, and its use as a vulnerary, aiding in the healing of wounds. The bioactive constituents of burr reed include a range of compounds, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, although further research is necessary to fully understand its composition and potential uses.
